slides.texte_overlay:
6 MORE signs a man is
quietly confident
1. He's comfortable eating alone at a nice restaurant. No phone, no rush. He enjoys his own company and the food.
2. He gives credit easily. "That was his idea." Confident men don't need to take the spotlight for everything.
3. He doesn't over-explain. A short answer, no long justification. He trusts that his reasons are enough. Short and sure.
4. He laughs at himself. Spilled drink, wrong name, bad joke. He shrugs and smiles instead of getting defensive.
5. He keeps learning. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it gives me a calm confidence in any conversation.
slides.texte_sophia: 5. I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It gives me a calm confidence in any conversation.

slides.texte_overlay: 6. He's kind when nobody's watching. Confidence doesn't need an audience to do the right thing. Character shows in private moments.
Quiet confidence shows in small, ordinary moments. Watch for them, and practise one this week. Start today.
